[Turnaround]
{a short turnaround that leads smoothly straight back into the main theme, same tempo and key}
positive_styles: gentle A minor warming toward C major
tender soft pulse-wave lead melody, faint and hummable
soft music-box arpeggio, slow and rounded
slow steady synth bass half notes like a quiet heartbeat
a single muffled soft drum pulse on the downbeat
a distant faint aurora swell once per phrase
snowbound village interior, lanterns in the dark, fireside warmth framed by cold
seamless transition back to the theme
